name: Sugoventure ~Dragon Master Silk Gaiden~
original_name: すごべんちゃー ～ドラゴンマスターシルク外伝～
source:
Sugoventure revolves around the four main heroines from the Dragon Master Silk series, Aka, Ao, Ki and Ruli, with the addition of a fifth heroine-- a hapless ordinary high school girl, Mitsuki Shirafuji, who is summoned into their world and joins them on their adventure.

The gameplay revolves around a board game setting; in accordance with the number of heroines, up to 5 players can take part (the Saturn's 6 Player Adaptor peripheral is required for this). When each player is controlling their character, they have the option of selecting dialogue choices before their turn, to influence how the character may feel about them.

[from [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/116338/sugoventure-dragon-master-silk-gaiden/]MobyGames[/url]]
translation:
《Sugoventure》围绕《龙之大师丝》系列中的四位女主人公阿嘉、青、木和瑠璃展开，并增加了第五位女主人公——倒霉的普通女高中生白藤美月，她被召唤到他们的世界并加入他们的冒险。

游戏玩法围绕棋盘游戏设置展开；根据女主角的数量，最多可以有5名玩家参加（为此需要Saturn的6玩家适配器外围设备）。当每个玩家控制他们的角色时，他们可以在轮到他们之前选择对话选项，以影响角色对他们的感受。

[来自[url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/116338/sugoventure-dragon-master-silk-gaiden/]MobyGames[/url]]
